Citizenship in his civic model did not include modern equal political rights for women. Popular sovereignty must not be translated into a claim that every adult was eligible irrespective of all exclusions.

A national government chosen by union leaders reproduces an executive ruling structure. Voluntary worker associations are not authorisation for trade union officials to replace the general electorate in choosing a state government.

He opposed coercive state taxation, but also the claim that reducing income differences has no justification. His collective-property programme makes an outright anti-equality rationale less plausible; the rejection is qualified because the question specifically names taxation.

Retaining individual earnings in a capitalist distributive order despite substantial inequality conflicts with collective economic emancipation. Opposition to state tax does not establish acceptance of entrenched income differences.

He endorsed material equalisation and opposed concentrated wealth while rejecting a coercive state tax-and-transfer apparatus. The proposition combines an endorsed aim with a contested means; Neutral is a substantive mixed response rather than a substitute for missing evidence.

His prejudiced racial conjectures concerned capacities and character while admitting limits of knowledge and effects of slavery. The presidency supported the Panama Canal and major public infrastructure while protecting forests and public lands. Substantial public benefits could outweigh habitat loss in some cases, so conservation is not a blanket veto on development.

His presidential-period abortion stance was personally restrictive and opposed federal financing beyond limited exceptions. Later public statements are outside the cutoff; ERA support does not settle social acceptance of early abortion.

Private commercial ownership was generally preferred while public NHS and infrastructure remained distinct exceptions.

Extensive divestment of publicly owned commercial firms was an implemented economic policy. CODELCO and crisis bank interventions qualify strategic exceptions rather than the general privatisation preference.
He signed the 2007 federal minimum-wage increase while favouring market allocation in ordinary production. Wage-floor legislation is distinct from economy-wide government wage schedules.

He claimed electoral legitimacy and continued contesting elections. Executive concentration and unfair competition do not establish a preference for a panel of experts to choose the national government instead of voters.

His stated governing legitimacy depended on national electoral support, including his response to local electoral losses. Weak checks qualify accountability in practice but do not establish endorsement of completely unaccountable rule.

Formal adult electoral participation was not conditioned on education or intelligence, including women’s participation. Restricted party competition is a different question from the adult franchise.
